dataList.content: Prioritize taking out the Grand Magasin Sisyphe Blueprints before Jeanne can finish them off with her "Focusing" Skill.
Когда Jeanne's "Engagement" effect is active, использует an Э.Г.О Skill with high Базовая сила to Clash against her.
Keep a close eye on Meursault's ХП.
Pay attention to Jeanne's intended pattern когда assigning Skill targets.
Be careful: грешников hit на Jeanne's Skills cannot roll Heads.
Taking out the Blueprints reduces Jeanne's ХП. Use Э.Г.О Skills with high Вес атаки to defeat them quickly.
Each time you win a Clash against "La Jouissance", The Crimson God [Adulthood] gains "Pwie's Memories" и becomes weaker.

Sinners who have "Shared with Pwie" получает меньше урона от The Crimson God [Adulthood], и The Crimson God [Adulthood] loses IQ each time they use a Skill against the said грешников.

Sinners whose effect changes to "Decision" наносит больше урона, but also получает more урона—exercise caution.

As L'Abject стаков, Speed decreases и урона taken from Bleed increases. грешников with 5 стака или more become Целится на for The Crimson God [Adulthood]'s powerful дополнительный attack. Exercise caution.
[Phase 1] Если a Sinner with 1 Speed Clashes with the Warden's Skill, its Power и Damage increase greatly. Even winning the Clash will still hurt.
[Phase 1] Если a Candle of Retribution survives, it inflicts Bind on все грешников на следующий ход в конце хода. Prioritize defeating it.
[Later Phases] Certain Skills of the enemy can be greatly weakened на Clashing with грешников who have "Thumping Pulse" или "Stillness".

[Later Phases] The enemy inflicts various types of Nails грешникам. The enemy's attacks grow stronger based on the target's Nail стаков, so keep an eye on your Nail стаков когда responding to the enemy's Skills.
